messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] billing-metering/token-count-drift detected for prod: token_delta > 3% over 10m. Pager sent to oncall. https://pd.redwood.example/pager/abcd
josh_oncall: I'm taking this. :pager:
maya_billing: I'm online, joining in 2m — what's the visible impact?
josh_oncall: Dashboard: late-ingest window + duplicated counts from emitter. Some customers seeing overage flags and early invoices. Sample IDs: C-142, C-903.
leo_support: Got 2 tickets reporting unexpected invoices. Holding customer comms until we confirm scope.
josh_oncall: pulling logs from emitter and consumer:
```
2026-03-18T02:12:45Z emitter pod-7: emitted=1200 counted=1400
2026-03-18T02:12:46Z kafka-consumer consumer-3: ack-lag=4m, reprocess_attempt=1
```
maya_billing: Looks like replayed messages + delayed consumer ack caused double-counting. Quick mitigations: pause replay pipeline and enable de-dupe at metering-proxy.
josh_oncall: Executing de-dupe toggle: `kubectl exec -n infra metering-proxy -- curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:9000/admin/de-dupe/enable` -> 200 OK :white_check_mark:
josh_oncall: Paused replay job: `/ops/run stop-replay --job=metering-replay` -> job stopping
maya_billing: That should stop new inflation. For historical correction we need a reprocess/backfill; estimate ~90m to complete with current window.
tess_pm: Are we recommending customer credits? Any regulatory concerns?
maya_billing: Yes, propose automatic credits for affected invoices + follow-up note. Recommend Sev2 for coordination and customer comms.
josh_oncall: Agreed. Support please prepare a short template (what happened, mitigation, credit, ETA for backfill).
leo_support: Drafting now; will paste for quick review in this thread.
maya_billing: I'll own reconciliation and final credit numbers. Assigning ana_sre to monitor overnight and ensure drift stays below 0.5% after mitigation.
ana_sre: Accepting handoff. I'll watch ingestion latency, consumer ack-lag, and job backfill progress. Will escalate if counts don't converge in 2h.
incident-bot: Incident update: assigned=josh_oncall, severity=sev2, mitigations=de-dupe_enabled,pause_replay, customer-impact=potential overcharge flags for a small subset of customers, next-handoff=ana_sre@1761115822
josh_oncall: Adding runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.example/incident/metering-drifts. Postmortem owner: maya_billing. Thanks team — keep updates brief in this thread. :thumbsup:
